_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30, but the sell-side read for ACN was share gain (J.P.Morgan, 2023-02-10) and the stock trades at 22.0x FY23E — near its own median, not an AI discount. Re-file under AI_EXPOSED only when the multiple starts discounting the legacy-services deflation J.P.Morgan describes, or it shows up in managed-services growth.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.45x; +22% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.70; conservative 2yr +14%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (the decade's worst year, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (decade CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.5%/yr (best 2-yr run of the decade); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2023-03-17) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.45x (20.4% downside to Bear $199 / +45.2% upside to Bull $363) | Adj composite 3.12 vs market 2.42: gap +0.70 [UNDERVALUED] | +22% above the EPP floor $204 (18x FY23E $11.36) | Conservative 2-yr case: +14.5% total (+7.3%/yr) | At 22.0x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $331 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; consulting +10% LC in Q1, Q2 guided +6-10% LC; GenAI is a live theme, read by the sell side as share gain for consultancies, not a threat.
